title: Open Up
subtitle: 詞性：phrasal verb · 片語動詞
description: 詞性：phrasal verb · 片語動詞

words.note: 表示把私人、敏感或令人困擾的事情告訴一個可信任的人。
words.example: He finally confided in his sister about how anxious he had been feeling.
words.exampleZh: 他終於向姐姐傾訴自己一直感到多麼焦慮。

exercises.original: After weeks of silence, he finally opened up to his best friend about the problems at home.
exercises.zh: 沉默了幾星期後，他終於向最好的朋友傾訴家中的問題。
exercises.upgrade: After weeks of silence, he finally confided in his best friend about the problems at home.

options.explanation: 看似合理，因為他確實和朋友談話；但 weeks of silence + problems at home 顯示內容私人而敏感，不只是一般談話。
私人問題 + trusted friend 是 confide in 的典型結構。
表示爭吵，和傾訴不同。
像正式匯報，不符合親密私人語境。
太輕鬆、日常，不能表達吐露心事。
通常是把資訊正式告知某人，不帶信任與私密感。

exercises.original: She only began to open up to her counsellor after several sessions.
exercises.upgrade: She only began to confide in her counsellor after several sessions.

options.explanation: 可能談到困擾，但 complaint 強調抱怨，不等於逐漸分享私人感受。
只表示交談，沒有深入信任意味。
counsellor + after several sessions 明確表示建立信任後才開始傾訴。
表示向某人提供工作資訊，語域不合。
是正式通知。
表示提問，不是分享。

exercises.original: He found it easier to open up to his older brother than to anyone else.
exercises.upgrade: He found it easier to confide in his older brother than to anyone else.

options.explanation: easier ... than to anyone else 暗示哥哥是特別信任的傾訴對象。
可以討論問題，但不一定涉及私密感受。
announcement 面向他人公布，不是私人傾訴。
通常是向專業人士尋求建議。
表示解釋某事，未必分享內心。
只是順帶提及，程度太弱。

words.note: 直接表示把內心感受說出來。
words.example: She found it difficult to share her feelings with her parents.
words.exampleZh: 她覺得很難向父母表達自己的感受。

exercises.original: She has always found it difficult to open up about how she feels.
exercises.upgrade: She has always found it difficult to share her feelings.

options.explanation: 可能談到發生了甚麼，但未必談自己的感受。
句中 how she feels 直接對應 feelings。
重客觀資訊，和情緒分享相反。
是公開發布資訊。
是指示他人做事。
是提出不滿，不等同分享所有感受。

exercises.original: The teacher encouraged students to open up about their worries before the exam.
exercises.upgrade: The teacher encouraged students to share their feelings about their worries before the exam.

options.explanation: their worries 是 emotional content，最直接就是分享感受。
和考試內容有關，但完全不是此句意思。
不一定涉及情緒。
是舉報不當行為。
可能談對課程的看法，但 worries 是個人感受。
談課綱，不是內心焦慮。

exercises.original: Over time, the children became more willing to open up about being nervous in class.
exercises.upgrade: Over time, the children became more willing to share their feelings about being nervous in class.

options.explanation: 承認錯誤可能需要坦白，但 being nervous 是感受，不是錯誤。
和 openness 無關。
being nervous 是直接情緒線索。
可能更願意參與，但不等於談自己的情緒。
只是描述環境。
可能是後續行動，但句中首先是在分享感受。

words.meaning: 坦率地談；開誠布公地談
words.note: 表示以誠實、不隱瞞的方式談某個問題、感受或經歷。
words.example: The team began to talk openly about the problems they were facing.
words.exampleZh: 團隊開始坦率討論他們面對的問題。

exercises.original: The two managers finally opened up about the problems affecting their teams.
exercises.upgrade: The two managers finally talked openly about the problems affecting their teams.

options.explanation: 只是交換資料，不表示坦率溝通。
finally + about the problems 表示之前未充分坦白，現在開始直接談。
可能只是一方抱怨，且 private 不等於 open communication。
通常是單向展示。
是特定談判內容，句中是 team problems。
較正式、對外，和雙方坦率交談不同。

exercises.original: The family began to open up about money after years of avoiding the subject.
exercises.upgrade: The family began to talk openly about money after years of avoiding the subject.

options.explanation: after years of avoiding the subject 是 decisive clue：現在不再避談。
坦率談不等於反覆爭吵。
是金錢交易，不是討論。
可能出現在家庭財務衝突中，但不等於開誠布公。
沒有投票線索。
只是警告。

exercises.original: Employees said they wanted a workplace where people could open up about mistakes without fear.
exercises.upgrade: Employees said they wanted a workplace where people could talk openly about mistakes without fear.

options.explanation: without fear 表示可以坦率討論，而不是隱瞞問題。
mistakes 不一定是 wrongdoing，而且 confess 帶更強罪責意味。
匿名舉報反而不是 openly。
談錯誤不一定要公開道歉。
不是所有 mistake discussion 都是 complaint。
和安全坦率的溝通文化相反。

words.note: 表示某件東西、服務、名額或選項開始可以被使用、取得、購買或申請。
words.example: More tickets will become available next week.
words.exampleZh: 下星期會有更多門票開始提供。

exercises.original: More appointment slots will open up next Monday.
exercises.zh: 下星期一會有更多預約時段開始可以預訂。
exercises.upgrade: More appointment slots will become available next Monday.

options.explanation: accessible 比較像「可以進入／接觸」，對 booking slots 不如 available 自然。
appointment slots + future booking 是最典型 availability 語境。
公開不等於可預訂。
公布時段和真正可預約是兩回事。
確認不表示開始有名額。
表示延長，而不是開始可用。

exercises.original: The new software feature will open up to all users after the trial period.
exercises.upgrade: The new software feature will become available to all users after the trial period.

options.explanation: feature + all users + after trial period 表示功能開始提供。
看得見不代表能使用。
也很合理，但 software feature rollout 通常更自然說 available to users。
宣傳不等於開放使用。
表示強制，不是開放。
只是審查。

exercises.original: Extra seats may open up if some guests cancel.
exercises.upgrade: Extra seats may become available if some guests cancel.

options.explanation: 不是「能進入」問題，而是原本沒有空位、之後可能有位。
取消預訂不必然令價格下降。
guest cancellation 直接釋放座位名額。
是相反方向：被預留後反而不再可供其他人使用。
表示被坐了。
不是取消預訂的自然結果。

words.meaning: 變得可進入；變得可接觸／使用
words.note: 表示某個地方、資訊、服務或系統開始可以被人進入或使用。
words.example: The upper floor will become accessible after the lift is repaired.
words.exampleZh: 升降機修好後，上層便可以進入。

exercises.original: The hiking trail will open up again once the damaged bridge has been repaired.
exercises.zh: 損壞的橋修好後，這條遠足徑將再次可以進入。
exercises.upgrade: The hiking trail will become accessible again once the damaged bridge has been repaired.

options.explanation: 也可泛指可使用，但 trail 的核心問題是 physical access，被橋阻斷。
bridge repaired → people can physically reach/use the trail again。
是否受歡迎和能否進入不同。
宣傳不等於開放通行。
沒有拓寬線索。
標示路線和通行能力不同。

exercises.original: After the archive is digitized, many old documents will open up to researchers online.
exercises.upgrade: After the archive is digitized, many old documents will become accessible to researchers online.

options.explanation: digitized + researchers online 直接表示資訊變得可以接觸和查閱。
沒有出售線索。
可查閱不等於所有權改變。
數碼化不代表可修改。
無關。
文件原本是否正式與 digitization 無關。

exercises.original: The museum's upper galleries will open up after the new lift is installed.
exercises.upgrade: The museum's upper galleries will become accessible after the new lift is installed.

options.explanation: 可以泛指開放，但 lift 是明確的 physical-access clue。
安裝升降機不會令 gallery 變大。
新 lift 直接改善進入上層展廳的能力。
方向相反。
安裝 lift 不等於展廳翻新。
不是此句重點。

words.note: 表示某個地方、服務、活動或機會開始對某群體開放，或某人開始願意接受新的想法／可能性。
words.example: The exhibition will become open to the public on Saturday.
words.exampleZh: 展覽將於星期六開始向公眾開放。

exercises.original: The new library wing will open up to the public next month.
exercises.zh: 新圖書館翼樓下個月將開始向公眾開放。
exercises.upgrade: The new library wing will become open to the public next month.

options.explanation: to the public 是 open to 的固定搭配。
available from 常接 time/source，不自然接 the public。
需要交通方式，例如 accessible by bus；介詞不合。
只是被知道，不等於可進入。
表示只保留給某群體，和 public opening 不同。
意思相反。

exercises.original: The scholarship will open up to international students next year.
exercises.upgrade: The scholarship will become open to international students next year.

options.explanation: 介詞錯，而且 scholarship 不是交通可達性。
scholarship + applicant group 是非常自然的 eligibility phrasing。
表示變成必要條件，意思不同。
表示只限某群體，方向相反。
表示知名度提高，不等於申請資格開放。
available from 通常接日期或來源，不接申請人群。

exercises.original: As the discussion continued, he gradually opened up to the idea of moving abroad.
exercises.upgrade: As the discussion continued, he gradually became open to the idea of moving abroad.

options.explanation: 這裡不是 physical opening，而是開始願意接受一個新可能性。
表示某人／物可供使用，不適合 personal attitude。
表示可接觸、可進入，不是態度改變。
表示已經作出更強的承諾；open to 只是願意考慮。
是責任關係。
只是變熟悉，不代表願意接受。

falseSynonyms.zh: 說話 ≠ 敞開心扉 speak 只表示說話，不保證內容私人、誠實或深入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone can speak a lot without opening up about how they really feel.

falseSynonyms.zh: 承認 ≠ 分享內心 admit 通常表示承認某個事實、錯誤或不願承認的事情；不等於一般分享感受。
揭露 ≠ 所有 open up reveal 強調把原本不知道的資訊揭示出來，可能是客觀資訊，不一定是情感分享。
可用的 ≠ 所有 open up 只有 open up 的 availability sense 才能和 available 接近。
可進入／接觸 ≠ 所有 available available 重「有得用／取得」；accessible 重「能到達／接觸／使用」。
打開 ≠ 所有 open up open the door 是物理動作；open up 還有情感分享和開始開放等抽象意思。
- open = 打開；開放 - open up = 打開；敞開心扉；開始開放 open up 的語義範圍更口語，也更具「開始變得開放」的動態感。
- opening = 開放／空缺／開幕 - availability = 可用性／可取得性 兩者都可能和 open up 的第二義相關，但不能直接當動詞替換。
